Embedded Software Engineer I

Alarm.com is a technology company developing cloud and device solutions for connected residential and commercial properties. The Embedded Software Engineer I will support the Device Engineering team by developing and maintaining embedded software, implementing and debugging features on hardware, and collaborating on device, cloud, and engineering initiatives.
Telecom & Communications
Internet of Things
Internet
Security
Wireless
Culture & Values
No H1B
Responsibilities
Work alongside senior engineers to develop and maintain embedded Linux applications, platform frameworks, and board support packages using C/C++
Implement, test, and debug well-scoped features and bug fixes on real hardware, growing toward independent ownership
Support device bring-up and validation with electrical and mechanical engineers
Contribute to features that connect our devices to the cloud, working with software engineers across teams
Participate in code reviews, write unit tests, and document your work to Alarm.com's standards
Communicate effectively and collaborate with others to ensure the timely delivery of projects
Qualification
C

Required
Bachelor's degree in computer science, Electrical/Computer engineering, or related field, or equivalent experience
0-2 years of professional experience; internships, co-ops, research, capstone, or personal projects involving embedded or systems software are welcome in place of industry experience
Proficiency in C and/or C++, with an understanding of software architecture and design principles
Proficiency in Linux and comfort working from the command line
Exposure to microcontrollers or single-board computers (e.g., STM32, ESP32, Arduino, Raspberry Pi, BeagleBone) and hardware peripherals such as UART, SPI, I2C, and ADC
Foundational understanding of electronics and the ability to read circuit schematics
Familiarity with version control systems such as Git
Strong problem-solving skills, curiosity about how hardware and software meet, and eagerness to learn from code review and mentorship
Clear written and verbal communication, and the ability to collaborate on a team
Please note that sponsorship of new applicants for employment authorization, or any other immigration-related support, is not available for this position at this time
Preferred
Experience with C++ in bare-metal and RTOS-based environments (FreeRTOS, Zephyr, ThreadX, or similar)
Experience with glibc, musl or bionic
Experience in threading, processes and other Linux Systems knowledge. Experience in Asynchronous and Messaging based designs (e.g., protobuf/nanopb)
Experience in building Linux kernels, device drivers, kernel modules, U-Boot, etc
Experience with cross-compilation and build frameworks such as Yocto, Buildroot, OpenWRT, or Android
Functional knowledge of security standards and protocols, such as TLS/SSL, OpenSSH, ECDSA/ECDH, AES256, HMAC, SHA256
Experience with designing firmware for video pipeline systems, image signal processing, or streaming protocols (RTSP, H.264/H.265) is a strong plus
Experience with running AI models on embedded device
Benefits

A 401(k) with an employer match

A collaborative and casual work environment
Employees work from the office 4 days a week
